title: Home layout, widget settings, and digest overhaul
summary: Reset Layout is now a smaller button and asks for confirmation before actually resetting.
Layout presets can be renamed, and the preset list is now always sorted alphabetically.
The Calendar Preview widget is resizable/draggable like every other widget, and can switch between Week, Day, Month, Agenda, and Hybrid views.
Widget content (text, numbers, icons) now scales fluidly and without an upper limit as you resize a widget, instead of stopping at a fixed size and leaving empty space.
Every Home widget has its own settings gear (edit mode) with settings tailored to that widget, using modern toggle/select controls with tooltips instead of plain checkboxes.
Widgets require a brief press-and-hold before dragging, so clicking into a widget's settings no longer triggers the drag state.
Bigger widgets now show extra detail when there's room: exact class time and notes on Next/Current Class, assignment/event descriptions, countdown weekdays, and reminder links.
Class links now always open in a new tab and correctly treat links without 'https://' as absolute instead of resolving them inside the app's own URL.
Classes page categories can be set to 1, 2, or 3 per row; a stranded single category in a row now goes full width automatically.

The Today and This Week digest banners gained new sections: countdowns landing today/this week, and a local usage-analytics summary (open streak, assignments completed, classes opened) -- both independently toggleable in the digest settings panel.
Fixed the Calendar Preview widget clipping/not shrinking with its box -- a CSS selector that was supposed to make it fill and scroll never actually matched.
Small colored text throughout the app now uses the lighter end of the current theme instead of a shade that was unreadable in several color palettes.
